reasons: Internal control and audit (0 of 4): no material weakness, adverse ICFR opinion, auditor change or disagreement flagged, which lowers risk. The card gives only area counts, not F/R IDs.
Prior-period corrections (0 of 3), investigations and litigation (0 of 3) and management turnover (0 of 2): none of the strongest after-the-fact or governance signals are present.

Financial pressure (2 of 4): two pressure items are present, for example incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS or a capital raise, or possibly going concern or covenant trouble. This gives a moderate motive to manage earnings.

Transaction complexity (2 of 8): two complexity items are present, for example over-time revenue, contract assets, related parties, customer concentration or an inventory write-down. These add some room for judgement in estimates.
Numeric warning signals (1 of 4 computable): one of the Beneish M, Dechow F, accruals or OCF/net income tests is tripped. It is a single quantitative flag and does not reinforce the others.
Overall: the moderate pressure and complexity, plus one numeric flag, are offset by clean controls and audit, no corrections and no investigations. Risk is low to moderate.
